intro: Oregon's knowledge test has 35 multiple-choice questions — you need 28 correct. Our Oregon bank follows the official online Oregon Driver Manual section by section.

testTypes.name: Class C driver license / instruction permit
testTypes.description: The 35-question knowledge test covering road signs, traffic laws and safe driving.

notes: The test includes questions about road signs, traffic laws and other information a driver needs. It has 35 multiple-choice questions; you must answer 28 correctly.
If you fail, you may test again the same day, depending on DMV office testing resource availability.

mockPresets.label: Full 35-question mock
mockPresets.description: Official format: 35 multiple-choice questions. Pass with 28 correct.

commonMistakes.text: Parking 10 feet from a crosswalk. Oregon's rule for crosswalks at intersections is 20 feet — the 10-foot rule is for fire hydrants.
Assuming teens can use hands-free phones. In Oregon, drivers under 18 may not use a mobile electronic device at all while driving.
commonMistakes.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Distracted Driving

commonMistakes.text: Turning left on red onto a two-way street. It's only allowed from a one-way road onto another one-way road.

faq.q: How many questions are on the Oregon knowledge test?
faq.a: 35 multiple-choice questions. You need 28 correct to pass.

faq.q: Can I retake the Oregon knowledge test the same day?
faq.a: Yes — you may test again the same day, depending on testing resource availability at the DMV office.

faq.q: How long must I hold my permit in Oregon?
faq.a: If you are under 18, at least 6 months before applying for a driver license.

questions.question: How many questions are on Oregon's knowledge test, and how many must you answer correctly?
questions.correctAnswer: 35 questions, 28 correct
questions.explanation: The test has 35 multiple-choice questions, and you must answer 28 correctly to pass.

questions.question: If you are under 18 and applying for an Oregon driver license, how long must you have held your permit?
questions.correctAnswer: At least 6 months
questions.explanation: You must have held a permit for at least 6 months if you are under 18 and applying for a driver license.

questions.question: If you take Oregon's knowledge test online and are under 18, who must supervise it?
options: A proctor over 21 years of age
questions.correctAnswer: A proctor over 21 years of age
questions.explanation: If under 18, a proctor over 21 years of age must supervise the online test.

questions.question: What must you do at an octagon-shaped STOP sign in Oregon?
options: Stop only if traffic is present
questions.correctAnswer: Come to a complete stop
questions.explanation: The STOP sign means you must come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does a triangular YIELD sign mean in Oregon?
options: Reduce speed and yield the right of way
questions.correctAnswer: Reduce speed and yield the right of way
questions.explanation: The YIELD sign means you should reduce speed and yield right of way.

questions.question: In Oregon, a High Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) lane is reserved for vehicles carrying at least:
questions.correctAnswer: Two persons
questions.explanation: The HOV lane is reserved for vehicles carrying at least two or more persons.

questions.question: In Oregon, what color are warning signs?
questions.correctAnswer: Yellow
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and alert you to known possible hazards.

questions.question: What does a Lane Reduction sign tell you in Oregon?
options: The indicated lane ends soon and vehicles in it must merge
questions.correctAnswer: The indicated lane ends soon and vehicles in it must merge
questions.explanation: The indicated lane ends soon; vehicles in that lane must merge.

questions.question: What does a steady red signal mean in Oregon?
options: Stop and remain stopped until the signal changes
Go if the road is clear
questions.correctAnswer: Stop and remain stopped until the signal changes
questions.explanation: A steady red signal means stop and remain stopped until the signal changes (except where turns on red are allowed).

questions.question: In Oregon, a flashing red signal is treated the same as:
questions.correctAnswer: A STOP sign
questions.explanation: A flashing red or a dark signal is treated the same as a stop sign.

questions.question: What does a steady yellow signal warn you of in Oregon?
options: The signal is about to turn red
The signal is about to turn green
questions.correctAnswer: The signal is about to turn red
questions.explanation: A steady yellow signal warns you that the signal is about to turn red.

questions.question: In Oregon, a flashing yellow signal means:
options: Slow down and proceed with caution
questions.correctAnswer: Slow down and proceed with caution
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow signal means slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.question: In Oregon, what does a steady green arrow mean?
options: You must yield to oncoming traffic
You have the right of way for that movement
questions.correctAnswer: You have the right of way for that movement
questions.explanation: A steady green arrow means you have the right of way.

questions.question: In Oregon, what does a flashing yellow arrow mean?
options: You have the right of way
You may make the movement, but you must yield first
questions.correctAnswer: You may make the movement, but you must yield first
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow arrow means you may make the movement indicated by the arrow, but first yield.

questions.question: If a traffic signal in Oregon is dark (for example, during a power outage), you should:
options: Stop as if there are stop signs in all directions
questions.correctAnswer: Stop as if there are stop signs in all directions
questions.explanation: If a signal appears dark, stop as if there are stop signs in all directions.

questions.question: What are Oregon 'safety corridors'?
options: Stretches of highway with more fatal and serious injury collisions
questions.correctAnswer: Stretches of highway with more fatal and serious injury collisions
questions.explanation: Safety corridors are designated stretches of highway with more fatal and serious injury collisions.

questions.question: What does Oregon's Basic Rule law require?
options: Always drive at the posted limit
Drive at a speed that is reasonable and cautious for existing conditions
Match the speed of other traffic
questions.correctAnswer: Drive at a speed that is reasonable and cautious for existing conditions
questions.explanation: You must drive at a speed that is reasonable and cautious for existing conditions.
questions.sourceSection: Lane Travel — The Basic Rule Law

questions.question: What is the speed limit in an Oregon school speed zone?
questions.correctAnswer: 20 mph
questions.explanation: The speed limit is 20 miles per hour within a school speed zone.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in an Oregon business district (unless posted otherwise)?
questions.correctAnswer: 20 mph
questions.explanation: The speed limit is 20 miles per hour in any business district.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in Oregon residential districts (unless posted otherwise)?
questions.correctAnswer: 25 mph
questions.explanation: The speed limit is 25 miles per hour in residential districts.

questions.question: In Oregon, what is the speed limit on roads and highways that don't meet any other definition?
questions.correctAnswer: 55 mph
questions.explanation: The speed limit is 55 miles per hour on all roads and highways not meeting any other definition.

questions.question: Oregon's manual defines a safe following distance as:
questions.correctAnswer: 2–4 seconds
questions.explanation: A safe following distance is defined as 2-4 seconds.

questions.question: At speeds greater than 30 mph in Oregon, your following distance should be:
questions.correctAnswer: 4 seconds or more
questions.explanation: For speeds greater than 30 mph, a safe following distance should be 4 seconds or more.

questions.question: On an Oregon road with a broken yellow center line, passing is:
options: Allowed for both directions of travel
questions.correctAnswer: Allowed for both directions of travel
questions.explanation: A broken yellow center line means passing is allowed for both directions of travel (when safe).
questions.sourceSection: Lane Travel — Broken yellow center line

questions.question: A double solid yellow line in Oregon means:
options: Passing is allowed for both directions
Passing is not allowed for both directions
Passing is allowed on the right
questions.correctAnswer: Passing is not allowed for both directions
questions.explanation: With a double solid yellow line, passing is not allowed for both directions of traffic.
questions.sourceSection: Lane Travel — Double solid yellow line

questions.question: In Oregon, when must your pass be started and completed?
options: It may start anywhere if no one is coming
It may not begin before a passing zone starts and must be completed before the zone ends
It must be completed within 10 seconds
questions.correctAnswer: It may not begin before a passing zone starts and must be completed before the zone ends
questions.explanation: Your pass may not begin before the start of a passing zone and must be completed before you enter the no-passing area.

questions.question: In Oregon, you may not pass when you are:
options: Approaching, at or in an intersection or railroad crossing
questions.correctAnswer: Approaching, at or in an intersection or railroad crossing
questions.explanation: Do not pass when you are approaching, at or in an intersection or railroad crossing.

questions.question: In Oregon, use your turn signal at least how far before a turn or lane change?
questions.correctAnswer: 100 feet
questions.explanation: Use your turn signal at least 100 feet before the turn or lane change.

questions.question: In Oregon, hand-and-arm signals should only be used when:
options: It is daylight and you can see people and vehicles clearly at 1,000 feet
You are in a parking lot
questions.correctAnswer: It is daylight and you can see people and vehicles clearly at 1,000 feet
questions.explanation: Only use hand-and-arm signals in daylight and when you can clearly see people and vehicles at 1,000 feet.

questions.question: In Oregon, may you turn left onto a two-way road against a red light?
options: Yes, if no traffic is coming
questions.correctAnswer: No, it is illegal
questions.explanation: It is illegal to turn left onto a two-way road against a red light.

questions.question: When may you turn left on red in Oregon?
options: From a one-way road onto a one-way road, after stopping and yielding
questions.correctAnswer: From a one-way road onto a one-way road, after stopping and yielding
questions.explanation: You may turn left from a one-way road onto a one-way road against a red light after stopping and yielding to traffic and pedestrians.
questions.sourceSection: Turns & Intersections — Left Turn: One-Way Road to One-Way Road

questions.question: At an Oregon four-way stop, who customarily goes first? And when in doubt?
options: The largest vehicle; yield to the left
The driver who stopped first; when in doubt, yield to the driver on your right
The fastest driver; when in doubt, honk
The driver on the left; when in doubt, go
questions.correctAnswer: The driver who stopped first; when in doubt, yield to the driver on your right
questions.explanation: It is common courtesy to let the driver who stops first go first. When in doubt, yield to the driver on your right.

questions.question: When entering an Oregon roundabout, you must yield to:
options: Traffic inside the roundabout and traffic exiting it
questions.correctAnswer: Traffic inside the roundabout and traffic exiting it
questions.explanation: You must yield to traffic inside as well as exiting the roundabout.

questions.question: In an Oregon multi-lane roundabout, it is illegal to:
options: Pass or drive beside a truck
questions.correctAnswer: Pass or drive beside a truck
questions.explanation: It is illegal to pass or drive beside a truck within the roundabout.

questions.question: In Oregon, U-turns are not allowed at intersections controlled by a traffic signal unless:
questions.correctAnswer: A sign permits the turn
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed at intersections controlled by a traffic signal, unless a sign permits the turn.

questions.question: When a school bus's red lights are flashing in Oregon, you must:
options: Stop before reaching the bus and stay stopped until the red lights are turned off
Honk and pass on the left
Stop only if children are visible
questions.correctAnswer: Stop before reaching the bus and stay stopped until the red lights are turned off
questions.explanation: When the red lights flash, stop before reaching the bus and remain stopped until the driver turns off the flashing red lights.

questions.question: In Oregon, you must yield to emergency vehicles using a light or siren when they approach:
questions.correctAnswer: From any direction
questions.explanation: You must yield right of way to emergency vehicles approaching from any direction using a light or siren.

questions.question: On an Oregon road with two or more lanes in your direction, what must you do when approaching a stopped vehicle with lights flashing?
questions.correctAnswer: Change lanes
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes going the same direction, you must change lanes when approaching any stopped vehicle with lights flashing.
questions.sourceSection: Sharing the Road — Approaching Stopped Vehicles

questions.question: May you share a lane with a motorcyclist in Oregon?
options: Yes, if the lane is wide
No — when passing, allow them a full lane
questions.correctAnswer: No — when passing, allow them a full lane
questions.explanation: It is against the law to share a lane with a motorcycle or moped rider; when passing, allow them a full lane.
questions.sourceSection: Sharing the Road — Motorcycles and Mopeds

questions.question: In Oregon, when must you stop for pedestrians crossing the road?
options: At any marked or unmarked crosswalk
questions.correctAnswer: At any marked or unmarked crosswalk
questions.explanation: You must stop for pedestrians crossing the road at any marked or unmarked crosswalk.

questions.question: Near a large vehicle in Oregon, if you can't see the driver in the vehicle's side mirror:
options: You are at a safe distance
questions.correctAnswer: The driver can't see you
questions.explanation: If you can't see the driver in the side mirror of a large vehicle, the driver can't see you.

questions.question: What happens to traffic fines in Oregon work zones?
options: They are tripled at night only
questions.correctAnswer: They are doubled
questions.explanation: Traffic fines are doubled in all work zones.

questions.question: In Oregon, a pedestrian carrying a white cane or using a guide dog:
options: Must wait for traffic to clear
Must be given the right of way
questions.correctAnswer: Must be given the right of way
questions.explanation: You must give the right of way to a pedestrian who is blind or deaf and blind carrying a white cane or using a guide dog.
questions.sourceSection: Sharing the Road — White Canes and Guide Dogs

questions.question: In Oregon, a flashing yellow light on a school speed sign indicates:
options: Children are arriving at or leaving school
A crossing guard is off duty
questions.correctAnswer: Children are arriving at or leaving school
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light on a school speed sign indicates children are arriving at or leaving school.
questions.sourceSection: Sharing the Road — Flashing School Speed Limit Sign

questions.question: When may you drive in an Oregon bike lane?
options: Never for travel, but you may cross it when turning or entering/leaving a driveway or alley
questions.correctAnswer: Never for travel, but you may cross it when turning or entering/leaving a driveway or alley
questions.explanation: Do not drive or park in a bike lane. You may cross a bike lane when turning or entering or leaving an alley, driveway or private road.

questions.question: During a police stop in Oregon, the manual recommends that you:
options: Keep your hands on the steering wheel
questions.correctAnswer: Keep your hands on the steering wheel
questions.explanation: Keep your hands on the steering wheel; passengers should keep their hands in plain view.

questions.question: In Oregon, where there is no stop line, how far from the nearest rail must you stop at a railroad crossing?
questions.correctAnswer: At least 15 feet
questions.explanation: Stop at least 15 feet from the nearest rail.
questions.sourceSection: Railroad Crossings, Light Rail and Street Cars

questions.question: At an Oregon railroad crossing with a posted STOP sign, you must:
options: Stop only if you see a train
Stop even if you do not see a train coming
questions.correctAnswer: Stop even if you do not see a train coming
questions.explanation: Stop before railroad tracks when a stop sign is posted, even if you do not see a train coming.
questions.sourceSection: Railroad Crossings, Light Rail and Street Cars

questions.question: In Oregon, who should go first — your vehicle or a streetcar?
options: Always let streetcars and trains go first
questions.correctAnswer: Always let streetcars and trains go first
questions.explanation: Always let streetcars and trains go first.
questions.sourceSection: Railroad Crossings, Light Rail and Street Cars

questions.question: In Oregon, you may not park within how many feet of a fire hydrant?
questions.correctAnswer: 10 feet
questions.explanation: Do not park within 10 feet of a fire hydrant.

questions.question: In Oregon, you may not park within how many feet of a marked or unmarked crosswalk at an intersection?
questions.correctAnswer: 20 feet
questions.explanation: Do not park within 20 feet of a marked or unmarked crosswalk at an intersection.

questions.question: Near a fire station driveway in Oregon, you may not park within:
options: 15 feet on the same side or 75 feet on the opposite side
25 feet on the same side only
questions.correctAnswer: 15 feet on the same side or 75 feet on the opposite side
questions.explanation: Do not park within 15 feet of a fire station driveway on the same side of the street, or within 75 feet on the opposite side.

questions.question: In Oregon, you may not park within how many feet of the nearest rail of a railroad or light rail crossing?
questions.correctAnswer: 50 feet
questions.explanation: Do not park within 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad or light rail crossing.

questions.question: When parallel parking in Oregon, your vehicle must be no more than how far from the curb?
questions.correctAnswer: 12 inches
questions.explanation: Park parallel to and no more than 12 inches from the curb.

questions.question: If you are 21 or older in Oregon, you fail an alcohol test at a BAC of:
questions.correctAnswer: 0.08 percent or more
questions.explanation: If you are 21 or over, you fail the test if your BAC is 0.08 percent or more.
questions.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Impaired Driving

questions.question: If you are under 21 in Oregon, you fail an alcohol test if your BAC is:
questions.correctAnswer: Any amount
questions.explanation: If you are under 21, you fail the test with a blood alcohol concentration of any amount.
questions.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Impaired Driving

questions.question: Under Oregon's implied consent rules, by driving you have agreed to:
options: Take a breath, blood or urine test when asked by a police officer
questions.correctAnswer: Take a breath, blood or urine test when asked by a police officer
questions.explanation: By driving a motor vehicle, you have agreed to take a breath, blood or urine test when asked by a police officer.
questions.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Impaired Driving

questions.question: In Oregon, is it legal to have an open container of alcohol in a vehicle on the road?
options: Yes, if it's in the back seat
Yes, if the driver is sober
questions.correctAnswer: No, it is illegal
questions.explanation: It is illegal to have an open bottle or other container with alcohol in it while you are in a vehicle on any road.
questions.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Impaired Driving

questions.question: In Oregon, may a 17-year-old driver use a cell phone while driving?
options: No — drivers under 18 may not use a cell phone or mobile electronic device while driving
questions.correctAnswer: No — drivers under 18 may not use a cell phone or mobile electronic device while driving
questions.explanation: It is illegal for drivers under 18 to use a cell phone or other mobile electronic device while operating a vehicle.
questions.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Distracted Driving

questions.question: In Oregon, drivers 18 or older who use a cell phone while driving must:
questions.correctAnswer: Use a hands-free accessory
questions.explanation: Drivers 18 or older must use a hands-free accessory to use a cell phone or other mobile electronic device.
questions.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Distracted Driving

questions.question: In Oregon, who must wear a safety belt?
options: All drivers and passengers in all available seating positions
questions.correctAnswer: All drivers and passengers in all available seating positions
questions.explanation: Safety belt use is mandatory for all drivers and passengers in all available seating positions.
questions.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Safety Belts

questions.question: In Oregon, children must ride in approved child safety seats until they are:
options: 8 years old or at least 4 feet 9 inches tall
questions.correctAnswer: 8 years old or at least 4 feet 9 inches tall
questions.explanation: Child passengers must be restrained in approved child safety seats until they are 8 years of age or at least 4 feet 9 inches in height.
questions.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Safety Belts

questions.question: In Oregon, infants must ride rear-facing until they reach:
questions.correctAnswer: 2 years
questions.explanation: Infants must ride rear-facing until they reach two years of age.
questions.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Safety Belts

questions.question: In Oregon, headlights must be on from:
questions.correctAnswer: Sunset to sunrise
questions.explanation: Headlights must be turned on from sunset to sunrise.
questions.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Using Lights

questions.question: Besides nighttime, Oregon requires headlights whenever conditions make it hard to see people or vehicles how far ahead?
questions.correctAnswer: 1,000 feet
questions.explanation: Lights must be on any time conditions make it difficult to see people or vehicles 1,000 feet ahead.
questions.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Using Lights

questions.question: Which of these is a warning sign of drowsy driving, according to Oregon's manual?
options: Lots of yawning, heavy eyelids and drifting out of your lane
questions.correctAnswer: Lots of yawning, heavy eyelids and drifting out of your lane
questions.explanation: Yawning, head nodding, heavy eyelids, blurred vision and not staying in your lane can mean you are falling asleep.
questions.sourceSection: Safe and Responsible Driving — Fatigue and Drowsy Driving
